body.name: Finite-library ellipsoidal risk game
body.construction: Primal: \(\min_{q\in\Delta_L,t\in\mathbb R}B^{2}t\) subject to \(Q(q)\preceq tH^{-1}\). Dual: \(\max_{X\succeq0,s\in\mathbb R}B^{2}s\) subject to \(\operatorname{tr}(H^{-1}X)=1\) and \(\operatorname{tr}(Q_{\ell}X)\ge s\) for every \(\ell\).
